visual_description: The image shows a hospital room with a healthcare worker in full personal protective equipment (PPE), including a face shield, mask, gown, gloves, and hair cover, standing beside a patient lying in bed. The patient is covered with a blue blanket and appears to be resting or asleep. A window behind them lets in bright daylight, and medical equipment such as an IV stand with hanging blue drapes is visible near the bed. In the foreground, there’s a plastic chair, a small stool, and a yellow trash bin next to a cabinet. An orange square with the number “2” is positioned in the top-left corner of the frame. No charts, tables, diagrams, or labeled axes are present. The scene is clear and well-lit.

The image shows a person wearing a white lab coat, face mask, and dark headscarf, handling a small white cooler with a blue lid on a wooden table. To the left of the cooler is an open box containing multiple light-blue vials or test tubes arranged in rows. A red square label with the number “3” appears in the upper-left corner of the frame. The background includes a patterned curtain and part of a window or glass door. No charts, tables, axes, or additional textual labels are visible beyond the numeral “3”.

The image shows an older man with white hair and a light blue surgical mask seated while receiving an injection in his left upper arm from a female healthcare worker. The worker wears a dark blue hijab, a light blue surgical mask, and a white lab coat; she holds a syringe and appears to be administering the shot. A small orange square with the number “4” is visible in the top right corner of the frame. No charts, tables, diagrams, or additional labels are present. The background is plain and light-colored, with a vertical pipe or conduit on the left wall.
